Kestrel Cloud Team

$12 per user per month, billed annually. Free trial, cancel anytime.

What the Team plan includes

Kestrel Cloud runs your pipelines on our infrastructure on a schedule or in response to an event, and keeps the run history, logs and output of every run for ninety days. The Team plan adds shared workspaces so a group can edit the same project, role-based access with viewer, editor and admin roles, and an audit log of who changed what. Each seat includes 500 pipeline runs a month; additional runs are billed at the end of the month at the rate shown on the pricing page.

Billing is per user per month and is charged annually in advance. You can add or remove seats at any time; added seats are prorated for the remainder of the term and removed seats are credited against the next invoice. The plan can be cancelled from the workspace settings page, and cancellation takes effect at the end of the current term. Data can be exported at any time in the same plain-file format that Kestrel Studio uses.

Support

Email support with a one-business-day response target, and a shared status page.
